title: 支柱と巻取ハンドル付きテニスネット
titleEn: Tennis net set with posts and crank
description: テニスコート場面へ据える、ネット・二本の支柱・張力金具の一式。実体のある縦横コード、中央へ下がる上端テープ、側端と下端の縁取り、中央押さえ帯、巻取箱とハンドル、反対側の固定金具、接地アンカーを造形。床・ライン・コート・ラケットは含まず、全体で1点です。網目は表示用に簡略化され、張力調整・競技規格・実用品の安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）13.388 × 1.151 × 0.350 m、29,488三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A net, two-post and tension-fitting assembly for tennis-court scenes. It has solid vertical/horizontal cords, sagged upper tape, side/bottom bindings, center retaining strap, crank housing and handle, opposite fixed cable anchor and grounded plates. Court flooring, lines and rackets are absent; the whole set counts as one model. The mesh spacing is simplified for visualization; tension adjustment, competition specifications and real-equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 13.388 × 1.151 × 0.350 m; 29,488 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
